title: 36 Hours in St. Martin/St. Maarten
abstract: Though one of the most densely developed islands in the Caribbean, St. Martin/St. Maarten remains a stunningly picturesque place, yet with ever more options for visitors.

title: 36 Hours in Seoul
abstract: Under a design-obsessed mayor, the city has been spiffed up with everything from sleek bus shelters to decked-out bridges.

title: 36 Hours in Cambridge, England
abstract: More than a centuries-old venerable university town, Cambridge boasts quirky art hangouts and lively watering holes and has even opened its dormitories to visitors who wish to stay awhile.

title: 36 Hours in Fort Lauderdale, Fla.
abstract: This resort town continues to mature beyond its spring-break days, now offering a sophisticated evening that doesn’t involve neon bikinis and syrupy daiquiris.
